additional_observation: Read-only profiler captures pipeline current baseline candidates, required because the official no_Q_exact_V2 branch has an empty competition records list. No engine hook is changed.
pixel_only: observable_P on current native labels; exact_v2.geometry invokes original V2 fit_circle/fit_ellipse and native-axis conversion. Ring validity and official Measurement remain unchanged.
pixel_bounds: Observable P bounding-box midpoint, extent=max span, rr_proxy=extent/2; image-pixel solver bounds, not estimated Ring geometry or metric scale.
pixel_selection: Only original valid finite V2 candidates. Minimize norm_residual_all + 0.005 for ellipse, 0 for circle, uniformly across frames. Rejected candidates retained.
Q_semantic: Curve intersection with native q + t*n should lie in [lo,hi]; Q is not an exact contour point. X is excluded.
roles: Original 001 FIT/HOLDOUT assignments kept; every other existing ledger frame UNSELECTED. Full 2D coverage does not add new 3D fitting frames.

files.FRAME.json: Identity, official audit, selected center/basis/weight and record ID, paths and SHA
files.CURVES.npz: Actual selected curve and P/Q/X arrays with contour/global identity, Q normal intervals
files.PROCESS.json.gz: Actual baseline candidates, full default A/B candidate pool including profiles/rejections and sample traces, selection plan, official variant summary, pixel fallback evidence
files.official/: Official diagnostic exporter audit, Ring points, P/Q/X solver records, full default geometry pool, pre-filter Q
